CREATE TABLE data.futures_data ( id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, id_symbol int4 NOT NULL REFERENCES data.symbol_futures(id), ts_db timestamp DEFAULT LOCALTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, last_price numeric, index_price numeric, mark_price numeric, prev_price_24h numeric, price_24h_pcnt numeric, high_price_24h numeric, low_price_24h numeric, prev_price_1h numeric, open_interest numeric, open_interest_value numeric, turnover_24h numeric, volume_24h numeric, funding_rate numeric, next_funding_time int8, ask1_size numeric, bid1_price numeric, ask1_price numeric, bid1_size numeric, funding_interval_hour int4, funding_cap numeric );
create index idx_futures_data_id_symbol on data.futures_data(id_symbol); create index idx_futures_data_ts_db on data.futures_data(ts_db);
